title: Restore the monthly sales report load time to under 5 seconds

sections.In plain terms: The monthly sales report has become slow to open since a recent release. It used to load in about 2 seconds and should load in under 5 again. Finance relies on it all day during month-end close, which starts next week.
sections.Context: Since last Tuesday's release the monthly sales report on the reports page loads slowly; before it loaded in about 2 seconds. Finance runs month-end close next week and uses this report throughout the day, so the slowdown will cost them time if it is not fixed before then.
sections.Acceptance Criteria:
1. The monthly sales report loads in under 5 seconds on the reports page
2. The cause of the slowdown introduced in last Tuesday's release is named in the pull request

waivers: structure: Out of scope is an optional section; the author has nothing to exclude
